name: Sushi & omakase
tagline: A precise, working template for a sushi counter that takes reservations.
description: A complete, working site for a sushi & omakase counter: a real omakase and à-la-carte menu, and a live reservations flow (counter seats and tables as bookable resources, an "Omakase counter" plus "Table for two/four" reservation services, two nightly seatings, a card-hold deposit and a cancellation policy) on the /reserve page. Minimal near-white paper theme, cool ink, a quiet indigo accent, a refined serif over a clean sans. Pages: Home, Menu, Reserve, About, Visit. Shipped as Nori.
